name: iopaint

storage.rationale: This tool has no tool-owned persistent storage in the supported Vrooli workflow; the explicit empty declaration records that caches or credentials are owned by the invoking workflow.

description: IOPaint object-removal / inpainting CLI for image-tools (Python/pip)
installHint: Python tool — install with `pipx install iopaint` (or `pip install iopaint`). Not a single-binary release, so it is not auto-fetched.
